اجترموا (form VIII)

# اُجْتُرِمُوا (ujturimū) /ud͡ʒ.tu.ri.muː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِجْتَرَمَ (ijtarama)
# اِجْتَرِمُوا (ijtarimū) /id͡ʒ.ta.ri.muː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِجْتَرَمَ (ijtarama)
